title: Remote probe and execution security
content: Remote probe and execution security Remote probe and remote execution seams are deny-by-default and policy-governed. For remote execution specifically: disabled unless NEMOCLAW_REMOTE_EXECUTION=1 auth metadata is redacted in diagnostics/receipts/events non-2xx, timeout, malformed response, auth rejection, and network-unavailable paths are explicit degraded truths no silent fallback and no trust escalation from probe-only data
summary: Remote probe and remote execution seams are deny-by-default and policy-governed.
